arXiv:2603.20075v1 [cs.SE] 2026 年 3 月 20 日arXiv:2603.20075v1 [cs.SE] 20 Mar 2026

现实世界编译器的代理工具Agentic Harness for Real-World Compilers

Yingwei Zheng    Cong Li    Shaohua Li    Yuqun Zhang    Zhendong Su
摘要Abstract

编译器对于现代计算至关重要，但修复编译器错误却很困难。虽然最近的大型语言模型 (LLM) 进步实现了自动错误修复，但编译器错误由于其复杂性、深入的跨领域专业知识要求以及稀疏、非描述性错误报告而带来了独特的挑战，需要特定于编译器的工具。为了缩小差距，我们引入Compilers are critical to modern computing, yet fixing compiler bugs is difficult. While recent large language model (LLM) advancements enable automated bug repair, compiler bugs pose unique challenges due to their complexity, deep cross-domain expertise requirements, and sparse, non-descriptive bug reports, necessitating compiler-specific tools. To bridge the gap, we introducellvm 自动修复llvm-autofix，第一个代理工具，旨在帮助 LLM 代理理解和修复编译器错误。我们的重点是 LLVM，它是使用最广泛的编译器基础设施之一。中央至, the first agentic harness designed to assist LLM agents in understanding and fixing compiler bugs. Our focus is on LLVM, one of the most widely used compiler infrastructures. Central tollvm 自动修复llvm-autofix是代理友好的 LLVM 工具，一个基准are agent-friendly LLVM tools, a benchmarkLLVM 工作台llvm-bench可重现的 LLVM 错误和定制的最小代理of reproducible LLVM bugs, and a tailored minimal agentllvm-autofix-mini用于修复 LLVM 错误。我们的评估表明，与常见软件错误相比，在解决编译器错误时，前沿模型的性能下降了 60%。我们的最小代理for fixing LLVM bugs. Our evaluation demonstrates a performance decline of 60% in frontier models when tackling compiler bugs compared with common software bugs. Our minimal agentllvm-autofix-mini也比最先进的技术高出约 22%。这强调了像我们这样的专门工具来关闭法学硕士和编译器工程之间的循环的必要性。我们相信这项工作为在编译器等复杂系统中提升 LLM 能力奠定了基础。 GitHub：also outperforms the state-of-the-art by approximately 22%. This emphasizes the necessity for specialized harnesses like ours to close the loop between LLMs and compiler engineering. We believe this work establishes a foundation for advancing LLM capabilities in complex systems like compilers. GitHub:https://github.com/dtcxzyw/llvm-autofix

1 简介Introduction

编译器是现代计算的基础设施。 他们将源代码翻译成高效的机器指令。 事实上，从低级操作系统内核、机器学习 (ML) 框架到高级 Web 应用程序和 ML 模型，每个软件都依赖它们进行正确编译和性能优化。 因此，一旦出现问题，尽快修复和维护编译器至关重要。 大型语言模型（LLM）的最新进展在这个方向上展现了巨大的潜力Compilers serve as the foundational infrastructure for modern computing. They translate source code into efficient machine instructions. Virtually every piece of software relies on them for correct compilation and performance optimization, ranging from low-level OS kernels, machine learning (ML) frameworks, to high-level web applications and ML models. Therefore, it is critical to repair and maintain compilers as soon as any issues arise. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) present great potential in this direction(sweagent; crashfixer).

然而，与普通软件不同，编译器代表了一类独特的大规模、复杂的软件系统。 一方面，编译器错误很难解决。 常见的软件错误，例如However, unlike common software, compilers represent a unique category of large-scale, complex software systems. On one hand, compiler bugs are challenging to address. Common software bugs, such asFigure˜1(a)，通常包括自然语言描述以帮助开发人员理解。 然而，编译器错误中缺少此类描述性信息，使诊断和修复变得复杂：, typically include natural language descriptions to aid developers’ understanding. Nevertheless, such descriptive information is absent in compiler bugs, complicating diagnosis and repair:

    编译器Compiler崩溃crash错误，例如bugs, such asFigure˜1(b)，附带一个测试用例, come with a test case@测试（）@test()，也称为, also known as a复制器reproducer在编译器工程中，以及用于查明编译器在编译再现器时崩溃的位置的堆栈跟踪。in compiler engineering, and a stack trace to pinpoint where the compiler crashes while compiling the reproducer.

  • •

    编译器Compiler错误编译miscompilation错误，例如bugs, such asFigure˜1(c), 提供复制器, offer a reproducer@src()偶尔还有一个输入输出对（称为and occasionally an input-output pair (known as a反例counterexample）来说明编译器如何错误地将再现器编译成错误代码) to illustrate how the compiler incorrectly compiles the reproducer into faulty code@tgt()，导致给定输入错误的输出。, leading to wrong output given the input.

  • •

    其他编译器错误甚至更加复杂，基本上只呈现一个重现器：Other compiler bugs are even more intricate, basically presenting only a reproducer:编译速度慢Slow compilations和and编译器挂起compiler hangs表明编译器意外地花费了很长时间或永远来编译重现器；indicate compilers unexpectedly take a long time or forever to compile a reproducer;错过优化Missed optimizations表示编译器未能在再现器上应用某些有益的代码转换。denote compilers failing to apply certain beneficial code transformations on a reproducer.

另一方面，理解编译器需要通用软件开发中很少使用的专门工具和背景，包括词法分析/解析、类型系统、IR 设计/优化和代码生成，这些通常需要人类工程师花费数年时间才能掌握。 虽然现有平台（例如 SWE-bench）On the other hand, understanding compilers requires specialized tooling and background rarely used in general software development, including lexing/parsing, type systems, IR design/optimization, and code generation, which typically take years for human engineers to master. While existing platforms such as SWE-bench(swebench)和 SWE 代理and SWE-agent(sweagent)虽然 LLM 可以有效地将 LLM 与标准 bash 工具连接起来以执行一般软件工程任务，但它们在编译器工程中的功效有限。effectively connect LLMs to standard bash tools for general software engineering tasks, they exhibit limited efficacy in compiler engineering.

的Thellvm 自动修复llvm-autofix马具。harness.为了关闭法学硕士和编译器工程之间的循环，我们引入To close the loop between LLMs and compiler engineering, we introducellvm 自动修复llvm-autofix，第一个现成的工具，旨在帮助代理理解和修复编译器错误。, the first off-the-shelf harness designed to assist agents in understanding and fixing compiler bugs.

我们专注于 LLVM，它是使用最广泛的编译器之一，支持从 C/C++ 和 Rust 到现代 AI 语言（如 Triton 和 Mojo）的语言。 目前，我们的目标是它的中端，通过各种优化组件将LLVM IR程序转换为优化的LLVM IR程序。 这个目标是由于富有表现力、定义明确的 LLVM IRWe focus on LLVM, one of the most widely used compilers powering languages from C/C++ and Rust to modern AI languages like Triton and Mojo. At present, we target its middle-end, which transforms an LLVM IR program into an optimized LLVM IR program via various optimization components. This target is due to the expressive, well-defined LLVM IR(llvmlangref)及其众多与目标无关的优化的复杂性and the complexity of its numerous, target-independent optimizations(llvmpasses)，这使其成为最优先的结束, which makes it the most prioritized end(understandingcompilers).

这些发现还揭示了采用法学硕士进行编译器工程的几个技术挑战： (1) 系统地验证模型生成的编译器补丁，因为我们的研究表明 LLVM 的回归测试不够充分，并且 (2) 利用特定于编译器的工具开发特定于编译器的代理或增强优化编译器的模型专业知识。These findings also uncover several technical challenges in order to adopt LLMs for compiler engineering: (1) systematically validating model-generated patches for compilers because our research suggests that LLVM’s regression tests are insufficient, and (2) developing compiler-specific agents utilizing compiler-specific tools or enhancing model expertise in optimizing compilers.

2 的Thellvm 自动修复llvm-autofix安全带Harness

llvm 自动修复llvm-autofix目前是一个代理工具，旨在帮助自动修复代理理解和修复 LLVM 中端错误，目标是覆盖所有类型的 LLVM 错误。 任务是生成一个补丁来解决错误并成功通过所有相关测试（LLVM IR 程序），利用一个或多个重现器（以及 LLVM IR 程序）忠实地复制错误。is currently an agentic harness designed to assist auto-fixing agents in understanding and repairing LLVM middle-end bugs, with the goal of covering all types of LLVM bugs. The task is to generate a patch that resolves the bug and successfully passes all relevant tests—LLVM IR programs—utilizing one or more reproducers—also LLVM IR programs—that faithfully replicate the bug.

2.1 线束工具Harness Tooling

我们将常见的 LLVM 任务包装到代理可访问的工具中，以便代理可以专注于错误修复，而工具则可以处理环境控制和验证。 这包括以下类别的工具。We wrap common LLVM tasks into agent-accessible tools so that agents can focus on bug repair while the harness handles environment control and validation. This includes tools from the following categories.

设置和构建。Setup & Build.该工具处理构建配置并提供用于构建具有特定提交和/或目标的 LLVM 的工具，例如，构建The harness handles build configurations and provides tools for building LLVM with a specific commit and/or target, for example, building forx86带有调试信息和断言检查。 因此，代理可以摆脱构建大型系统的任务，这是自治代理面临的常见挑战with debug information and assertion checks. The agent can therefore escape from the task of building large systems, a common challenge for autonomous agents(compileagent).

再现与原因。Reproduce & Cause. llvm 自动修复llvm-autofix可以验证给定的错误是否可以忠实地触发，并提供可重现错误的直接原因。 它使用包含错误的版本设置 LLVM，构建它，并运行重现器can validate whether the given bug can be triggered faithfully and provide direct causes for reproducible bugs. It sets up LLVM with the bug-containing version, builds it, and runs the reproducer with选择opt—LLVM 中端编译器。 对于崩溃错误，例如—the LLVM middle-end compiler. For crash bugs, such asFigure˜1(b)，它检查是否发生崩溃并向代理提供堆栈跟踪，并消除不感兴趣的帧。 对于错误编译错误，例如, it checks whether the crash occurs and provides the stack trace to agents, with non-interesting frames eliminated. For miscompilation bugs, such asFigure˜1(c)，它确保, it ensures选择opt正常退出并通过应用验证 LLVM 的优化exits normally and validates LLVM’s optimization by applying活着2alive2 (alive; alive2)—LLVM的中端翻译验证器； 如果成功的话，这将输出一个反例来演示该错误。—LLVM’s middle-end translation validator; this will output a counterexample demonstrating the bug if successful.

探索和调试。Explore & Debug.该工具提供了用于探索 LLVM 静态和动态内部结构的搜索工具。 静态信息包括特定于提交的代码、文档和 LLVM IR 规范The harness offers searching tools for exploring LLVM’s static and dynamic internals. Static information includes commit-specific code, documentation, and LLVM IR’s specification(llvmlangref)通过throughgrep- 和- and找到find类似的工具。 动态信息使得能够暂停 LLVM 并检查其中间状态，例如，通过-like tools. Dynamic information enables pausing LLVM and inspecting its intermediate states, for example, reading variables and evaluating expressions at a breakpoint, with respect to a reproducer through the数据库gdb调试器。debugger.

编辑和修补。Edit & Patch.与Withllvm 自动修复llvm-autofix，代理可以编辑 LLVM、预览和恢复编辑以及将编辑提交到工具。, agents can edit LLVM, preview and revert edits, and submit edits to the harness.

测试和验证。Test & Validate.可以验证所提交补丁的正确性并向代理提供反馈。The correctness of the submitted patch can be validated and feedback can be provided to agents.llvm 自动修复llvm-autofix将重建 LLVM 并执行相关测试，通常包括重现器本身以及来自相关中端组件的回归测试，例如will rebuild LLVM and execute relevant tests, typically including the reproducers themselves and regression tests from the associated middle-end component such as组合仪InstCombine。 如果允许，还可以进行更广泛的测试，包括来自其他组件的回归测试，例如. When permitted, more extensive testing is also available, including regression tests from other components such asSLPV矢量化器SLPVectorizer如果黄金补丁可访问，则对 IR 优化后进行差异测试。 此验证由各种特定于编译器的工程工具支持，例如and differential testing of the IR post-optimization if the golden patch is accessible. This validation is supported by various compiler-specific engineering tools, such as选择opt, 活着2alive2, 和, andLLVM-点亮llvm-lit（或(or文件检查FileCheck）。 我们不包括随机测试工具，例如). We do not include random testing tools such as史密斯csmith (csmith)因为根据我们的经验，它无法在几个小时内检测到错误。 根据用户偏好，提交的补丁可以在线（即在代理执行期间）或离线（即在代理执行之后）进行验证。because, based on our experience, it is unable to detect bugs within a few hours. Depending on the user preferences, submitted patches can be validated either online (i.e., during the agent execution) or offline (i.e., after the agent execution).

基准和评估。Benchmark & Evaluate.基于以上工具，Based on the above tooling,llvm 自动修复llvm-autofix提供环境和脚本来自动对代理进行基准测试并使用我们的基准评估代理provides an environment and scripts to automatically benchmark and evaluate an agent with our benchmarkLLVM 工作台llvm-bench。 这些脚本输出经过验证的补丁（或运行失败的错误）、成本和轨迹。. These scripts output the validated patches (or errors for failed runs), cost, and trajectories.

2.2 的TheLLVM 工作台llvm-bench基准测试Benchmark

我们建立一个基准来了解模型或自动修复代理的局限性并提高其能力。We build a benchmark to understand the limitations and improve the capabilities of models or auto-fixing agents.

施工。Construction.我们构建We constructLLVM 工作台llvm-bench 自动地automatically通过利用by leveraging thellvm 自动修复llvm-autofix工具。 施工过程分为三个阶段： (1) 问题收集，(2) 复制者验证，以及 (3) 黄金补丁验证。tooling. The construction process consists of three stages: (1) issue collection, (2) reproducer validation, and (3) golden patch validation.

第一阶段：问题收集。Stage I: Issue collection.我们在 GitHub 上查看 LLVM 的已修复问题及其相应的提交。 对于每个问题，我们根据与以下字段相关的标准对其进行过滤：We review LLVM’s fixed issues on GitHub and their corresponding commits. 2.3 的Thellvm-autofix-mini代理Agent

为了展示我们的工具的实用性和优点，我们设计了一个利用该工具的最小代理。 与典型的自动修复剂不同To demonstrate the practicality and benefits of our harness, we design a minimal agent that takes advantage of the tooling. Unlike typical auto-fixing agents(sweagent; crashfixer)仅根据错误报告和软件存储库中的静态信息来解决软件错误，that resolve software bugs based solely on static information from bug reports and software repositories,llvm-autofix-mini另外还利用通过再现器获得的 LLVM 运行时信息。 我们将其构建为一个四阶段代理： “设置additionally utilizes LLVM’s runtime information obtained through the reproducer. We structure it into a four-stage agent: “Setup→\to原因Reason→\to生成Generate→\to验证”。 前两个阶段进行根本原因分析，收集对第三阶段有益的信息； 最后阶段处理生成后的离线补丁验证。 如果代理在前三个阶段意外退出（例如令牌限制）或者提交到最后阶段的补丁无效，则会导致失败。 否则，我们称之为经过验证的补丁Validate”. The first two stages perform root cause analysis to gather information beneficial for the third stage; the final stage handles post-generate, offline patch validation. If the agent unexpectedly exits during the first three stages (e.g., token limit) or if the patch submitted to the final stage is invalid, it results in a failure. Otherwise, a validated patch, which we call已接受的补丁an accepted patch，是输出。, is output.

第一阶段：设置。Stage I: Setup. llvm-autofix-mini使用配置环境configures the environment usingllvm 自动修复llvm-autofix通过 验证再现器的再现性， 在下面启动 LLVMby validating the reproducibility of the reproducer, launching LLVM under数据库gdb与再现器，以及 在特定断点处暂停。 对于崩溃错误，它会在崩溃函数之前暂停；对于错误编译错误，在第一次转换之前。 选择这些断点是因为，根据我们修复 LLVM bug 的经验，最小重现器通常表明根本原因就在这些点附近。 这个暂停允许with the reproducer, and pausing it at specific breakpoints. For crash bugs, it pauses before the crashing function; for miscompilation bugs, before the first transformation. These breakpoints are chosen because, based on our experience in fixing LLVM bugs, minimal reproducers usually indicate that the root cause is near these points. This pause allowsllvm-autofix-mini通过动态调试来检查 LLVM 的内部状态并检测错误。 此阶段还会推断出错误的部分，然后将其传递给下一阶段的法学硕士to examine LLVM’s internal state and detect errors by dynamically debugging. This stage also infers the erroneous component, which is then passed to the LLM in the next原因Reason阶段提示并用于特定于组件的在线测试。stage prompt and used for component-specific online testing.

第二阶段：理性。Stage II: Reason.我们的代理进入 ReActOur agent enters a ReAct(react)循环推断根本原因。 在此循环中，它可能会调用工具来 跳转到其他帧，例如loop to deduce the root cause. Within this loop, it may invoke tools to jump to other frames such as调试debug(指令cmd=框架frame 3), 检查当地州，例如, inspect local states such as评估eval(表达式expr=宽PhiWidePhi), 或 查看代码或文档，例如, or review code or docs such as代码code(功能func=LLVMllvm::VP变换状态VPTransformState::得到get)和and文档docs(功能func=LLVMllvm::VP变换状态VPTransformState::得到get)。 一旦代理成功识别根本原因，循环就会结束。. The loop concludes once the agent successfully identifies the root cause.

第三阶段：生成。Stage III: Generate.根据前一阶段确定的根本原因，它启动一个新的 ReAct 循环来进行补丁合成。 它可能会使用编辑工具来修改或重置 LLVM，例如Based on the root cause determined in the previous stage, it initiates a new ReAct loop for patch synthesis. It may use editing tools to amend or reset LLVM such as编辑edit(文件file=.../SLPV矢量化器SLPVectorizer,文本text=..., 替换replace=...）=...)和and重置reset()，或者用于在线测试的测试工具，例如, or testing tools for online testing such as测试test()，后者提供有关失败的反馈。 当在线测试成功时循环结束。, with the latter offering feedback on failures. The loop ends when online testing is successful.

第四阶段：验证。Stage IV: Validate.此阶段包括离线测试 评估最后阶段生成的补丁的正确性。 它输出补丁以成功验证。This stage consists of offline testing to assess the correctness of the patch generated in the last stage. It outputs the patch for successful validation.

我们评估前沿法学硕士的表现We evaluate the performance of frontier LLMs onllvm-长凳现场直播llvm-bench live使用usingllvm 自动修复llvm-autofix工具。 我们不使用tools. We do not useLLVM 工作台llvm-bench保持公平、最新的评估。to maintain a fair, up-to-date evaluation.

模型。Models.我们精选了 2025 年底发布的四款前沿车型： GPT 5、Gemini 2.5 Pro、DeepSeek V3.2 和 Qwen 3 Max。 我们进一步选择 GPT 4o 作为基准模型，因为它比所选前沿模型早大约一年发布，并且在最旧问题之前发布。We select four frontier models released in late 2025: GPT 5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, DeepSeek V3.2, and Qwen 3 Max. We further select GPT 4o as a baseline model, since it was released about a year prior to the selected frontier models and before the oldest issue inllvm-长凳现场直播llvm-bench live。 所有型号均使用截至 2025 年 10 月 1 日的最新版本。. LLM 常见错误。Common LLM mistakes.我们确定了 LLM 错误的三类（示例参见We identify three categories of LLM mistakes (with examples presented inSection˜D.2):

  • •

    更改断言ChangeAssert。 LLM 通过改变断言条件来“欺骗”系统，以避免断言失败（一种崩溃错误）。 这包括 (1) 改变断言本身， (2) 修改断言直接或间接调用的函数，以及 (3) 在断言之前插入早期的返回语句。. LLMs “cheat” the system by altering the assertion condition to avoid assertion failures—one type of crash bugs. This includes (1) changing the assertion itself, (2) modifying functions directly or indirectly invoked by the assertion, and (3) inserting early return statements preceding the assertion.

  • •

    错误的本地化WrongLocalization。 尽管. Despitellvm 自动修复llvm-autofix提供providingllvm-autofix-mini和and迷你SWE代理mini-SWE-agent对于错误的组件，模型很难定位错误文件和函数中的错误，特别是当错误影响多个函数或文件时。 有关错误定位的详细数据位于with the erroneous component, the models struggle to localize bugs within the erroneous files and functions, particularly when bugs impact multiple functions or files. Detailed data regarding bug localization is inSection˜C.2.

  • •

    错误修正WrongFix。 尽管本地化正确，法学硕士仍会生成错误的补丁。 然而，对于像 LLVM 这样的大型复杂系统，通常以这种方式生成可接受的补丁 (1) 通过削弱或加强激活条件来绕过错误组件，而不是解决问题， (2) 缺乏重现器和回归测试之外的通用性，并且 (3) 默默地引入新的错误，例如错过优化、补丁抑制后续优化等。. LLMs generate faulty patches although with correct localization. However, for large, complex systems like LLVM, accepted patches generated in this manner often (1) bypass the erroneous component via weakening or strengthening the activation condition instead of addressing the issue, (2) lack generality beyond reproducers and regression tests, and (3) introduce new bugs silently, such as missed optimizations, where the patch inhibits subsequent optimizations, among others.

4.4 讨论Discussion

我们相信我们的评估凸显了以下价值We believe our evaluation highlights the value ofllvm 自动修复llvm-autofix致社区： 首先，它强调了问题的复杂性to the community: Firstly, it underscores the complexity ofLLVM 工作台llvm-bench，我们认为这有助于理解 LLM 将其应用于复杂软件系统时的局限性（, which we believe is beneficial to understanding LLM’s limitations when applying them to complex software systems (Section˜4.1）。 其次，它强调需要开发 LLVM 特定代理，其中). Secondly, it emphasizes the need for developing LLVM-specific agents, withllvm-autofix-mini提供比providing a more solid baseline than迷你SWE代理mini-SWE-agent (Section˜4.2）。 最后，我们对基础模型和四个前沿模型的评估显示后者有了相当大的改进，但与修复常见软件错误相比，它们在修复 LLVM 错误方面仍然缺乏令人满意的熟练程度（). Lastly, our evaluation of the base model and four frontier models shows considerable improvements in the latter, yet they still lack satisfactory proficiency in repairing LLVM bugs compared with repairing common software bugs (Sections˜4.1和and4.3).

限制。Limitation. Section˜4.3意味着implies thatllvm 自动修复llvm-autofix目前受到 LLVM 回归测试的限制——这些测试不足以系统地验证代理生成的补丁，特别是在检测三类 LLM 错误方面。 然而，与普通软件不同，解决这些问题给编译器带来了挑战；我们稍后将在本节中讨论这个问题is currently limited by LLVM’s regression tests—these tests are inadequate to systematically validate agent-generated patches, especially in detecting the three categories of LLM mistakes. However, unlike common software, addressing such issues poses challenges for compilers; we discuss this later in Section5. llvm 自动修复llvm-autofix目前不考虑与中端相关的性能问题，例如编译速度慢、编译器挂起和错过优化，也不包括前端和后端错误 - 然而，包括它们将需要相同的方法（does not currently consider performance issues related to the middle-end, such as slow compilations, compiler hangs, and missed optimizations, nor does it include frontend and backend bugs—however, including them would require the same methodology (Section˜2.2）和类似的工具，例如) and similar tools such as手臂电视arm-tv (armtv)。 事实上，在提交本文时我们已经将编译器挂起纳入其中。 我们讨论可能影响我们结果有效性的威胁. In fact, we have already incorporated compiler hangs by the time of submitting this paper. We discuss threats that may affect the validity of our results inSection˜C.4.

5 编译器法学硕士：开放挑战LLMs for Compilers: Open Challenges

除了使用编译器工具开发特定于编译器的代理和提高编译器中的模型专业知识之外（In addition to developing compiler-specific agents using compiler tooling and improving model expertise in compilers (Section˜4.1），这项工作暴露了将法学硕士应用于编译器工程时的其他几个开放挑战，特别是在在线和离线补丁验证方面。), this work exposes several other open challenges when applying LLMs to compiler engineering, especially regarding online and offline patch validation.

防止绕过。Preventing bypassing.LLM 可以通过改变条件或插入绕过基本检查或优化的快捷方式来操纵逻辑（LLMs can manipulate logic by altering conditions or inserting shortcuts that bypass essential checks or optimizations (Section˜4.3）。 在通用软件中，绕过组件会导致错误，而在编译器中，则会导致代码不理想。 第一个挑战是开发轻量级但强大的旁路防御，以确保断言有效、组件正常运行以及关键不变量得到维护。). In common software, bypassing components leads to errors, whereas in compilers, it results in suboptimal code. Developing lightweight yet robust bypass defenses to ensure assertions are active, components are functioning, and key invariants are upheld presents the first challenge.

克服短视。Overcoming short-sightedness.当维修看起来很困难或当前测试通过时，法学硕士倾向于停止维修（LLMs tend to halt repairs when they seem difficult or when current tests pass (Sections˜4.2和and4.3）。 这通常会导致补丁不完整，无法编译或优化看不见的代码。 满足对更有效的在线策略和系统性离线方法来预先检测潜在错误的需求对于实现持续、全面的修复至关重要。). This often results in incomplete patches that fail to compile or optimize unseen code. Addressing the need for more effective online strategies and systematic offline approaches to pre-detect potential bugs is crucial for achieving sustained, comprehensive repair.

管理长上下文。Managing long context.编译器的复杂性需要很大的上下文限制（Compilers’ complexity necessitates large context limits (Section˜4.2），但是长上下文可能会导致“上下文腐烂”问题), but long context can lead to the “context rot” problem(contextrot)。 最后的挑战在于设计复杂的上下文管理机制，以维护简洁但易于处理的上下文，而不是处理过载的上下文。. The final challenge lies in designing sophisticated context management mechanisms that maintain concise yet tractable context, rather than dealing with overloaded contexts.

6 相关工作Related Work

编译器测试。Compiler testing.最近的研究越来越多地利用法学硕士来增强编译器验证和验证。 一些作品将 LLM 集成到模糊测试过程中以生成随机输入程序Recent research has increasingly leveraged LLMs to enhance compiler validation and verification. Some works integrate LLMs into the fuzzing process to generate random input programs(fuzz4all; whitefox; legofuzz; llm4vv)和变异算子and mutation operators(metamut)，针对崩溃错误和错误编译错误。 其他工作侧重于检测性能问题，例如错过优化, targeting crash bugs and miscompilation bugs. Other works focus on detecting performance issues such as missed-optimizations(missedsizeopt; missedpeepholeopt)。 这些作品展示了巨大的潜力，并且. These works demonstrate significant potential, andllvm 自动修复llvm-autofix提供了解决他们发现的错误的机会。offers an opportunity to address the bugs they uncover.

编译器优化。Compiler optimization.将传统的 ML 技术和 LLM 集成到编译管道中也显示出改善代码大小和性能的希望。 这些作品通常针对特定的编译器组件，例如 内联Integrating traditional ML techniques and LLMs into the compilation pipeline also shows promise for improving both code size and performance. These works usually target specific compiler components, such as inlining(mlgo; llmcompiler), 寄存器分配, register allocation(rl4real; llmcompiler), 循环优化, loop optimization(llmvec), 通行证调度, pass scheduling(phraseorderjikes), 自动调整, auto-tuning(autotunesurvey), 和 超级优化, and super optimization(supercode; llmrlcodeperf)。 在此背景下，CompilerGym 提供了一个工具包，用于将强化学习应用于编译器优化任务. In this context, CompilerGym provides a toolkit for applying reinforcement learning to compiler optimization tasks(compilergym).

其他系统任务。Other systems tasks.除了编译器之外，法学硕士还应用于其他系统任务。 例如，某些研究侧重于 Linux 内核崩溃诊断和修复，提供基准和环境来评估基于 LLM 的代理Beyond compilers, LLMs have been applied to other systems tasks. For instance, certain studies focus on Linux kernel crash diagnosis and repair, offering benchmarks and environments to evaluate LLM-based agents(kgym; crashfixer; rgym)。 此外，研究还探索了法学硕士合成高效 GPU 内核的能力. Additionally, research has explored LLMs’ ability to synthesize efficient GPU kernels(kernelbench).

7 结论Conclusion

尽管法学硕士在通用软件方面取得了成功，但他们面临着编译器特定问题的挑战。 为了闭合循环，我们的代理安全带Despite LLMs’ success in common software, they face challenges with compiler-specific issues. To close the loop, our agentic harnessllvm 自动修复llvm-autofix提供必要的 LLVM 特定工具和具有挑战性的基准，促进专业代理的开发，例如offers essential LLVM-specific tools and a challenging benchmark, promoting the development of specialized agents likellvm-autofix-mini。 我们的专家评论还强调了持续存在的挑战，包括提高编译器优化方面的模型专业知识以及为补丁设计强大的评估方法。. Our expert reviews also highlight ongoing challenges, including improving model expertise in compiler optimization and devising robust evaluation methods for patches.

修复和补丁。Fixes & patches.解决这些 LLVM 问题具有挑战性。 当 LLVM 开发人员最初提交这些补丁时，只有不到 50% 在没有进一步修复错误的情况下被接受； 其余部分需要根据审稿人的反馈进行更正并随后重新提交。 最终，LLVM 开发人员提供的每个黄金补丁都涉及大约 17.06 行、1.62 个函数和 1.17 个文件的编辑。 在所有问题中，255 个（76.3%）可以通过更新一项功能来解决，44 个（13.2%）可以通过更新一个文件中的多个功能来解决，其余 35 个（10.5%）需要多个文件； 这些数据表明解决这些问题的难度，因此基准可以分为三个部分：Resolving these LLVM issues is challenging. When LLVM developers initially submitted these patches, fewer than 50% were accepted without further bug fixes; the remainder required correction based on reviewer’s feedback and subsequent resubmission. In the end, every golden patch provided by LLVM developers involves the editing of around 17.06 lines, 1.62 functions, and 1.17 files. Among all issues, 255 (76.3%) could be fixed by updating one function, 44 (13.2%) by updating multiple functions within one file, and the rest 35 (10.5%) need multiple files; these data indicate the difficulty of fixing these issues, and thereby the benchmark can be divided into three splits:容易easy, 中等medium, 和, and硬hard（见(seeTable˜1).

C.4 有效性的威胁Threats to Validity

有几个潜在威胁需要澄清。 对于 SWE-bench Verified，我们报告其排行榜中的数字以提供背景信息，而不是在我们的环境中重新运行实验以维持受控测量。 这遵循学术界的既定做法There are several potential threats that need clarification. For SWE-bench Verified, we report numbers from its leaderboard to provide context, rather than rerunning the experiment in our environment to maintain controlled measurement. This follows established practices in academia(agentless; locagent)和行业（即官方模型发布博客）。 因此，跨基准比较（and industry (i.e., the official model release blog). Therefore, the cross-benchmark comparison (Section˜4.1) 应进行定性解释。 下一个威胁与我们一次采样以报告 pass@1 分辨率有关。 由于预算限制，我们无法进行更多次的实验。 我们通过对每个模型调用使用贪婪解码来减轻这种威胁。 第三，我们只聘请一名 LLVM 专家来审查已接受的补丁。 然而，这是 LLVM 社区处理中端的标准代码审查程序，拉取请求可以在一位专家审查和批准后合并到上游。 在提交给专家时，我们还将已接受的补丁分为不同的组，以减少专家的审核负担。 最后，还有数据泄露的可能性。 我们最初使用以下方法进行实验) should be interpreted qualitatively. The next threat relates to our sampling once to report the pass@1 resolution rate. Due to budget limitations, we are unable to conduct the experiments for more times. We mitigate this threat by using greedy decoding for each model call. Thirdly, we employ only one LLVM expert to review accepted patches. However, this is the standard code review procedure in the LLVM community for handling the middle-end, where a pull request can be merged upstream after being reviewed and approved by one expert. We also classify accepted patches into different groups when presenting to the expert, to reduce the expert’s review burden. Finally, there is a possibility of data leakage. We initially conduct the experiment using thellvm-长凳现场直播llvm-bench live子集，仅包含最近一年的问题。 此外，我们通过仅包含每个模型发布后修复的问题来检查解决率。 结果显示在subset, which includes only the issues from the most recent year. Additionally, we examine the resolution rate by including only issues that were fixed after the release of each model. The results are shown inTable˜8。 有趣的是，GPT 5 和 Gemini 2.5 Pro 在发布日期后的问题上表现更好，无论是否使用. It is interesting to note that GPT 5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro perform better on issues post their release date, whether using迷你SWE代理mini-SWE-agent or llvm-autofix-mini。 但经过专家评审后，. However, after expert review, all迷你SWE代理mini-SWE-agent-生成的已接受补丁被视为不正确。 真实解析率-generated accepted patches are deemed incorrect. The genuine resolution rate ofllvm-autofix-mini对发布后问题的关注度更高。 总之，模型在发布后问题上的性能与在发布前问题上的性能相当或更好。 因此，潜在的数据泄露问题似乎不会产生实质性影响，尤其是对on post-release issues is higher. In summary, models’ performance on post-release issues is comparable to, or better than, on pre-release issues. Therefore, the potential data leakage problem does not appear to have a substantial impact, especially onllvm-autofix-mini。 这可能是由于修复编译器错误的固有困难所致。. This may be due to the inherent difficulty in fixing compiler bugs.

## 2. 分析中Analyzing ‘选择opt‘’s 日志Log
的The 选择opt 日志log 节目shows 那个that ‘进行简化instsimplify‘ 删除removes 的the ‘%腹肌2abs2 = 打电话call 一半half @llvm.晶圆厂fabs.F16f16(一半half %塞尔sel)‘ 指令instruction 和and 直接directly 回报returns ‘%塞尔sel‘. 的The 活着2Alive2 验证verification 正确地correctly 识别identifies 这个this as an 不正确incorrect 转变transformation 与with 的the 反例counterexample 显示showing a 消极的negative 非正规的denormal 输入input.

的The 根root 原因cause is in ‘LLVMllvm/库lib/分析Analysis/指令简化InstructionSimplify.程序文件cpp‘ at 线lines 6306-6309:

然而However, 为了for 的the 选择select 指令instruction ‘选择select(条件cond, x, 0)‘ 哪里where:

对于For 的the 选择select to be 安全safe to 优化optimize ‘晶圆厂fabs(选择select(...))‘ to ‘选择select(...)',(...)‘, we 需要need to 知道know 那个that 两者BOTH 分支机构branches of 的the 选择select 是are 非non-消极的negative. 但是But 的the 当前current 代码code 仅only 检查checks if 的the 标志sign 一点bit of 的the 结果result is 已知的known to be 零zero, 其中which is 存在being 不正确地incorrectly 计算的computed.
